title: Brand Mark
intro: A peak on a blue tile, locked to a two-tone wordmark set as one name. Every mark on this page is rendered live by the same components the site itself ships — not a screenshot — so what you see here is exactly what visitors get.

rationale.title: Why it looks like this
rationale.lead: The mark and choices each carry a meaning tied to what the company does.

items.body: An upward triangle with a notch cut from its base — three readings at once: the initial A-like apex of a summit (growth, ambition of the businesses you serve), a checkmark-adjacent silhouette (approval — quotes signed, appointments confirmed), and a subtle FS ligature reduced to pure geometry. Solid fill = certainty; nothing decorative.

A rounded square is the most "software" of shapes — an app icon by construction. Blue #2f6bff is the trust color of B2B, but pushed brighter than corporate navy so it reads intelligent and current, not bureaucratic.

"Francisco" in accent blue, "Solis" in ink navy — one name, two words made legible without a space or hyphen. The color split does the job punctuation would, which mirrors the product philosophy: structure without friction.
A geometric sans with slightly humanist curves — precise letterforms (enterprise-ready) that avoid the coldness of stricter grotesques (not overly corporate).
Ink navy #0f2440 for authority, one bright accent for action, near-white surfaces — the restraint itself signals "we handle serious business documents."

lockup.title: Primary lockup
lockup.body: The mark and the wordmark travel together. FranciscoSolis is one name: no space, no hyphen, and no line break between the words.
lockup.note: On dark surfaces "Francisco" lightens to #4d82ff and "Solis" goes white. Everywhere else it stays #2f6bff over ink navy.

stacked.title: Stacked variant
stacked.body: For square placements and social profiles, where the horizontal lockup would have to set too small to stay legible.

mark.title: The mark alone
mark.body: Used for avatars, favicons, and app icons. It never sets below 16 px — under that the peak's shoulders close up and the tile's radius starts eating the artwork.
mark.mono_body: For single-color and print contexts. Reach for this instead of recoloring the tile.

color.title: Color
color.body: The palette is fixed. Click any value to copy it.

roles.on_dark: Accent on dark — "Francisco" over dark surfaces
roles.ink: Ink navy — "Solis" and the mono mark

type.title: Typography
type.body: The wordmark is Sora SemiBold (600) at −2% letter-spacing. Sora is reserved for the wordmark — the product UI runs on Inter and does not need to match.

clear_space.title: Clear space
clear_space.body: Keep clear space equal to half the mark's height on every side of any lockup. Where a container's own padding already meets that — as the site header's does — don't add it a second time.
clear_space.label: half the mark's height

donts.title: Don'ts
items: Don't stretch or squash the mark
Don't place it on low-contrast backgrounds
Don't separate the words or change the casing

code.title: Using it in code
code.body: In this site, compose the lockup from the React components rather than linking the SVG files. The reference SVGs set the wordmark as SVG text in Sora, which resolves against locally installed fonts only — anywhere Sora isn't installed the wordmark silently falls back to a system sans and loses its shape. The components draw the mark inline and set the wordmark as real text in the webfont, so it stays crisp, selectable, and readable to screen readers.

assets.title: Assets
assets.body: Vector sources, plus raster exports at 4×. Use these for handoff — design tools, documents, and third parties.
